en.title: Maximum Riders Within Comfortable Group Size Ranges
en.description:
Passenger i is only willing to ride with between low[i] and high[i] other passengers. You may choose any subset of passengers to ride together, and every member must be within their own range. Find the maximum number of passengers; the empty set is valid.

This site has made the standard input and output explicit; any range not given by the source is marked as this site's protocol.
en.input: The first line contains n, followed by n lines of low high; 1≤n≤100000, 0≤low≤high≤n.
en.explanation: Example 1: with 3 riders you can pick any three passengers whose ranges cover 2; with 4 riders only 3 ranges cover 3, so the maximum is 3. Example 2: all three accept the other two, so the answer is 3. Example 3: both require 2 others, but there are only 2 people in total, so the answer is 0; this also corrects the original third example, where high=3 exceeded n=2, an invalid range.
hints: A group size k is feasible if and only if at least k ranges cover k−1. Use a difference array to count how many ranges cover each number of others, then find the largest feasible k.
